attributes.context: Section 4, which defines technological change as significant changes in equipment or materials affecting employee work or headcount.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding notification requirements for proposed technological changes.

extraction_text: The Employer will advise the affected Local Unions and the National Teamster/UPS Committee for Technological Change of any proposed technological changes when the change has entered the field testing phase or at least six (6) months prior to the implementation of such change except where the change was later determined in which case the Employer shall provide as much notice as possible. In all cases, the Company will provide notice of any technological change covered by this Section before the technology is implemented.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding information sharing between the Employer and the Technological Change Committee.

extraction_text: The Employer shall be required to provide the National Teamster/UPS Committee for Technological Change, any relevant information to the extent available regarding the technological changes.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding effects bargaining for technological changes.

extraction_text: The Employer will meet with the National Teamster/UPS Committee for Technological Change, promptly after notification to negotiate regarding the effects of the proposed technological changes.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding the rights and authority of the Technological Change Committee.

extraction_text: The Technological Change Committee shall also have the right to raise and attempt to resolve any claim that the Company’s technological change violates any provision of the National Master Agreement or the applicable Supplement, Rider or Addendum.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding the allocation of work resulting from technological change.

extraction_text: If a technological change creates new work that replaces, enhances or modifies bargaining unit work, bargaining unit employees will perform that new or modified work.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding employer obligations for employee training on new technology.

extraction_text: The Employer shall provide bargaining unit employees with training required to utilize the new technology, if necessary.

attributes.context: Section 4 regarding the dispute resolution process for technological changes.

extraction_text: In the event that the National Committee cannot reach agreement on the dispute, either party may refer all outstanding disputes to the National Grievance Committee for expedited resolution in accordance with the provisions of Article 8 in order to determine if the Employer has violated the provisions of this Section or if the change will result in a violation of any other provision of the collective bargaining agreement.
